lines.en: Grandma, do you have a pet?
Yes, I have an old cat. She is sleeping.
lines.ko: 네, 늙은 고양이가 있어요. 자고 있어요.

lines.en: I want a dog. Dogs are fun.
When I was young, I had a big dog.
Did it bark a lot in those days?
Yes, when a mouse came, it barked hard.
What about a rabbit? Rabbits are quiet.
A rabbit is a good pet. Its tail is soft.
I will feed it every day. Really!
Good. Let's ask your mom this evening.
Hello! Your dog looks very happy.
Thank you. We walk here every morning.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 우리는 매일 아침 여기서 걸어요.

lines.en: Does he bark at other animals?
Sometimes. Yesterday he barked at a wild cat.
Look, his tail is moving. Is he happy?
Yes. He likes people. You can pet him.
He is so soft. What do you feed him?
Dog food and a little chicken.
My rabbit at home is a quiet pet.
Nice! We will visit your rabbit next time.
